title: Tsunami message
description: A U.S. tsunami warning center message in one of four levels (Tsunami Warning, Tsunami Advisory, Tsunami Watch, Tsunami Information Statement) or a Cancellation. It carries the message number, the issue time, the areas, a short evaluation with preliminary earthquake parameters, estimated arrival times by place, recommended actions and the next update. A watch is for a possible threat and is not sent as a Wireless Emergency Alert; warnings and advisories can be.

areas.description: Areas under the message (coastal zones or counties, up to 8)

examples: The outer coast of Westport County from Cape Hollis to Harbor Point

evaluation.description: Evaluation: what happened and what is expected
examples: A strong earthquake occurred near the coast at 0622 AM PST. Based on the earthquake location and magnitude a destructive tsunami is possible for coasts near the source.
Magnitude 7.9 (preliminary), 0622 AM PST, 46.8 N 124.4 W, depth 20 km

arrivals.description: Estimated first wave arrival by place (up to 8)

examples: Move inland to high ground or out of the tsunami hazard zone now. Do not wait for official confirmation. Stay away from the coast until local officials say it is safe.
The next message will be issued within 30 minutes or sooner if conditions warrant.

wirelessAlertSent.description: Whether this message was also sent as a Wireless Emergency Alert (never for a Watch)
